name: gap_to_vwap_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY gaps and continues to deviate 20+ basis points below (or above) the developing session VWAP, VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms — index fund rebalancers, derivatives book delta-hedgers, and program traders tracking VWAP as their execution benchmark — begin accumulating against the gap direction to keep fills close to their VWAP target. On NIFTY, where these institutional flows are dominant and continuous, this creates a measurable first convergence thrust of 15-25 spot points within 60-90 seconds once RSI exhaustion signals the selling (or buying) pressure has peaked. At 5-second resolution we enter as the EMA(5) micro-cross confirms the institutional absorption has begun.
core_signal_oneliner: Gap day with VWAP deviation > 20 bps: RSI(12) at extreme and EMA(5) micro-cross confirms institutional absorption beginning, entry toward VWAP
